minimum.description: The minimum quantity required to trigger this bulk pricing discount.

maximum.description: The maximum quantity (or 0 for unlimited) to trigger this bulk pricing discount.

tax_discount_amount.description: Formats the `bulk_pricing.discount_amount` into the tax price amounts.

as_entered.description: The price provided by the merchant as entered in their catalog/price list; may include or exclude tax.

tax_inclusive.description: The estimated tax inclusive price for this product based on the provided customer group.

tax_exclusive.description: The estimated tax exclusive price for this product based on the provided customer group.

entered_inclusive.description: Determines whether the 'as_entered' price is inclusive or exclusive of tax based on the store's tax jurisdiction.
